stem.text: The diagram shows a uniform rod, XY, that is freely hinged to a vertical wall at end Y. The rod is at an angle of $60^{\circ}$ to the wall.

stem.alt: Uniform rod XY with end X at lower left and end Y hinged to a vertical wall at upper right. A force F arrow at X makes 30° with the rod. A downward arrow labelled 3.0 N acts on the rod. Angles 30° and 60° are marked. Labels: wall, rod, hinge, X, Y, F, 3.0 N, not to scale.

stem.text: A force $F$ acts at an angle of $30^{\circ}$ to the rod at end X. The rod has a weight of $3.0\,\text{N}$ and is in equilibrium.
What is the magnitude of force $F$?
